title: CLEARTOX: Development of an innovative haemodialysis method to improve dialytic clearance of protein-bound uraemic toxins
official: CLEARTOX: Development of an innovative haemodialysis method to improve dialytic clearance of protein-bound uraemic toxins
summary: Main objective: Compare the clearance of p-cresyl sulfate during dialysis (from H0 to H4) between a hemodialysis session with infusion of a medium-chain fatty acid emulsion (Medialipide®) and a hemodialysis session with infusion of saline.
conditions: chronic hemodialysis patients (for more than 3 months) with no residual diuresis (<100 mL/day).

interventions.name: MEDIALIPIDE 20 POUR CENT, émulsion pour perfusion
CHLORURE DE SODIUM FRESENIUS 0,9 %, solution pour perfusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age ≥18 years
2. Receiving dialysis prescribed at a frequency of three sessions per week for at least one month
3. For patients of childbearing potential, highly effective contraception (e.g. total sexual abstinence, combined hormonal contraception, bilateral tubal obstruction, etc.) is required for the entire duration of treatment. A blood pregnancy test (beta-HCG) will be performed at inclusion.
4. Patient affiliated to a social security scheme
5. Free, informed and written consent signed by the patient
6. Patients who are anuric or have a quantified residual urine output of ≤ 500 mL
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patients with unstable metabolic conditions (e.g. severe post-traumatic syndrome, coma of unknown origin)
2. Patient already on parenteral nutrition
3. Patients with sepsis < 1 month
4. Patient already on antivitamin K (or prescribed less than one month prior to inclusion)
5. Patient with heparin allergy or requiring hemodialysis without anticoagulant (recent hemorrhage)
6. Patients allergic to egg, soy or peanut proteins or to any of the active ingredients or excipients (glycerol, egg phospholipids for injection, a-tocopherol, sodium oleate (for pH adjustment), water for injection) of Médialipide®
7. Patients with severe hyperlipidemia or severe lipid metabolism disorders characterized by hypertriglyceridemia > 3 mmol/l
8. Patients on non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs
9. Patients under legal protection
10. Persons incapable of expressing their consent
11. Persons deprived of their liberty and emergency situations.
12. Patients in the acute phase of myocardial infarction or stroke
13. Patient with severe liver failure or cholestasis
14. Patient with known severe coagulopathy
15. Patient with acute thromboembolic events
16. Patient with fat embolism
17. Patient with an aggravating bleeding diathesis
18. Patient with uncompensated metabolic acidosis
19. Patient with an unstable circulatory state threatening the vital prognosis (collapse and shock)
20. Pregnant or breastfeeding
21. Patients with uncorrected disturbances of fluid and electrolyte balance, such as hypokalemia and hypotonic dehydration
22. Patients with decompensated heart failure
23. patients with acute pulmonary edema
24. Subject having participated in another interventional research study in the 30 days prior to inclusion in the study or still within 5 half-lives of the experimental product of a previous interventional research study.
25. Uncontrolled hypertension > 180/115 mmHg
26. Perdialytic hypotension requiring vascular filling > 100 mL during the last 3 sessions
